comment: Sketch1 on XY for Blend Curve (mitcad#2107): two fixed points that frame the view's fit at (-40, -30) and (40, 30); a line from (-30, 15) to (-20, 15) and one from (-10, 5) down to (-10, -5), to blend with Tangent from the first's end to the second's start; an arc of r 5 about (0, -20) from (0, -25) counter-clockwise to (5, -20) and one of r 5 about (20, -5) from (20, -10) to (25, -5), to blend with Curvature from the first's end to the second's start.
